_comment: Files that tools/strip-source.mjs minifies in place before you publish.
The whole project is in this repo; only the frontend is deployed (.vercelignore).
tools/**      - the strip tool itself must stay runnable.
ECG/code/**   - vendored upstream HuBERT-ECG research code (CC BY-NC 4.0).
Not ours to rewrite, and it must stay attributable.
config files  - package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json and the Tailwind
and PostCSS configs stay readable so the project still builds.
